questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In C-Am-F-G, which chord is the tonic 'home' chord?
questions.why: C is the 'I' or tonic chord, built on the first scale degree — the point of rest the progression returns to.

questions.subject: Visual Arts
questions.prompt: In Paint Like a Beast, besides brushes, what else did students use to apply paint?
questions.why: Students used sponges and rags alongside brushes to build up loose texture, not just fine brushwork.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these roles in Japan's feudal hierarchy, from most power to least
questions.why: Power ran Shogun, then Daimyo (regional lords), then Samurai (warriors serving them), then Peasants at the base.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these steps of judging whether an event marks continuity or change, from first to last
sequence: Decide how significant the difference is
questions.why: To judge continuity and change you first describe before and after, then pinpoint what actually differs, then weigh how significant that difference really is.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: What does Prince Escalus threaten if the families fight in Verona's streets again?
questions.why: Escalus declares that anyone caught brawling again will be put to death — he's trying to end the feud with the harshest possible threat.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: Roughly what years did Shakespeare live, birth to death?
questions.why: Shakespeare was born in 1564 and died in 1616, placing his life firmly in the Elizabethan and early Jacobean era.
